listing.description_html:
The perfect first coloring book for your little one!

Made for toddlers ages 1 to 3, every page shows one big, simple picture with extra thick lines: a puppy, an apple, a car, a ball, a sun and many more friendly things your child already knows. It is a great way to practice colors, first words and early scribbles.

  • 40 simple illustrations with one object per page
  • Extra thick lines made for chunky crayons
  • Single sided pages so markers never bleed onto the next picture
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch format

Screen free fun that builds early learning and fine motor skills. Add it to your cart today!
